summary: dsh-evolve-modes is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that provides composable controls for task execution, reasoning strategy, quality checks, and human-reviewed self-evolution rules to configure and review AI agent workflows.

classificationSuggestion.reason: This plugin is primarily an agent-workflow orchestration plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web: it adds composable controls for execution mode, reasoning style, and quality gates, plus a human-reviewed self-evolution loop that proposes persistent rules from session history. Evidence from README and package metadata shows integration with DSH services (including plan-mode and quality review flows), UI command entry points, and plugin-specific storage, with no indication that it edits project files directly.
